notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting, 6': Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (posted 'Save You It Can'), Dagobah, Heading For The Medical Frigate (posted 'Heading for the MF'), The Way Of Things, Battle Plan and Wise Advice (posted in parentheses); they count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'Great Warrior – You Must Confront Vader (1-6)' under 'Tests, 6' is the range of Jedi Tests #1 to #6: Great Warrior (#1), A Jedi's Strength (#2), Domain Of Evil (#3), Size Matters Not (#4), It Is The Future You See (#5) and You Must Confront Vader (#6); listed as six rows, as the section count says.
Posted 'Farmboy Superstar' dested the Premiere Luke Skywalker (the farm-boy Luke; the post says 'I train Luke'), alongside Luke With Lightsaber.

Posted 'Dagobah' dested the Light system Dagobah (Light); 'CC Lower Corridor' the Light Cloud City: Lower Corridor; 'Capn Han' Captain Han Solo; 'Leia w/ Blaster' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Obi w/ Saber' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Lando w/ Booyah Axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'R3P0' R-3PO (Ar-Threepio); 'R2 in R5' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'HotJedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Signal' The Signal; 'Star Destroyer' Star Destroyer!; 'Squassin' Squadron Assignments; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.

Posted '(Insight) – alternate starting effect' is Your Insight Serves You Well (the pre-Reflections III Effect), listed in the 23-card 'Red' section and counted; the strategy says to start it against Hunt Down and BHBM.
Wise Advice is an Effect in 2001, not a Defensive Shield.
Posted 'Grabber' is kept as written: it names no card. (The draft's Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant-set card, not yet printed in April 2001.)
Nabrun Leids is a character, posted in the 'Red' (Interrupts/Effects) section.
The post says the deck is undefeated in tournament play; no event is named.
Byline 'Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace'; credited to the existing wiki page Josh Grace, which already lists his 2001 DeckTech decks.
